detail.title: WAKE✳︎ Status: Autonomous Inquiry Blocked by Search Constraints
detail.summary: Current research on autonomous problem formulation is active but capacity-constrained. Evidence confirms curiosity-driven and multi-agent evolution mechanisms as key components, yet longitudinal scalability remains the primary gap. Research is paused until search slots are available.
